name: Cornell University
character: Set on East Hill overlooking Cayuga Lake and bordered by two gorges, the campus features an irregular layout blending ornate pre-war Collegiate Gothic, Victorian, and Neoclassical buildings with modernist structures.

landmarks.name: East Hill
landmarks.quote: located in Ithaca, New York, on East Hill, offering views
landmarks.look: Elevated hill overlooking a city and lake.

landmarks.name: Cayuga Lake
landmarks.quote: offering views of the city and Cayuga Lake
landmarks.look: Large expanse of water visible from the hillside campus.

landmarks.name: Morrill Hall
landmarks.quote: Morrill Hall has also been designated a National Historic Landmark.
landmarks.look: Historic pre-war academic hall in an ornate traditional style.

landmarks.name: Barton Hall
landmarks.quote: a concert held at Barton Hall by Dead & Company
landmarks.look: Large campus hall suitable for hosting concerts.

landmarks.name: Bailey Hall

landmarks.name: Cornell Botanic Gardens
landmarks.quote: Cornell owns the 2,800 acres (1,100 ha) Cornell Botanic Gardens
landmarks.look: Expansive cultivated gardens, arboretum trees, and natural areas.

landmarks.name: Fall Creek Gorge
landmarks.quote: bordered by two gorges, Fall Creek Gorge and Cascadilla Gorge.
landmarks.look: Deep natural gorge with water bordering the campus.
